messages:
maria_cs: Quick check — NorthPoint asked to split the renewal invoice into two (50/50) and prorate a seat add from 2026-03-25 to 2026-04-30. They prefer e-signature instead of issuing a PO. Can we do split + prorate and keep current pricing? cc @kevin_ae
kevin_ae: thx. Customer confirmed list price ok. I have verbal approval for the seat add at current rate. Need to confirm effective date and invoice timing.
emma_fin: We can split invoices, but finance needs a PO for each invoice to process against GL. E-sign is fine for the contract amendment, but billing ideally wants a PO for Net45 processing.
maria_cs: Procurement said they won't issue a PO until 4/1 (year-end budget opens). They want us to e-sign now and invoice immediately. Any workaround for billing?
jordan_pm: maybe do amendment that e-signs now, invoices 50% now, and defers second invoice until 4/1. Prorate the seat add for the partial month.
legal-bot: Use amendment template: https://docs.internal/redwood/contracts/amendment-prorate. Clause 3.2 covers prorated seat adds and deferred invoices. DocuSign e-sign is approved.
emma_fin: If Proc won't PO, we can still invoice but collections risk increases. Options: (1) Invoice now as requested and track AR risk, (2) Put second invoice date = 2026-04-01 and wait for PO before sending, or (3) Invoice now and mark "PO pending" in notes. Need billing contact and AR sign-off.
maria_cs: billing contact is sara@northpoint.com — procurement contact is mike.procure@northpoint.com
emma_fin: ok opening draft. Example invoice lines below for approval:
```
Line 1: Hosted API - Annual commitment (50%) - $60,000
Line 2: Seat add prorate (2026-03-25 to 2026-04-30) - $1,200
Line 3: Hosted API - Remaining 50% - $60,000 (to invoice on/after 2026-04-01)
```
invoicing-bot: Draft invoice created ID INV-2026-4512 for review — includes split and prorate lines. Link: https://erp.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-4512
kevin_ae: I'll send the amendment via DocuSign today and flag the procurement team. Will ask buyer to provide PO for the second invoice on 4/1. :thumbsup:
maria_cs: perfect — I'll ping the buyer and update this thread with their response. Thanks everyone!
